group8_screen.criterion_text:
Group8 query screen; recorded before timing.
Purpose: test a distinct ordinary-source single-backing, group-aligned probe, not replay the rejected sidecar control representation. Retire this scratch record with the prototype; move surviving methods and outcomes into map-library/RESULTS.md.
Control: current running-index library compiled by frozen enum-domain CLI, exactly the same compiler as candidate. Compare candidate controls plus Array<HashMapSlot<K,V>,8> grouped in one Box<Slots<Group>> allocation. No primitive, source-admission, ABI, or backend changes belong to this factor.
Inputs: existing four-peer isolated lookup harness, salted mix64, seeds101..109, 64/4096 actual payload slots, half occupied, 8/256-byte payloads, hit/miss. Group order is aligned; equality/ownership semantics require the actual enum check, read-only callbacks, and no stable bucket-position promise. Setup/full-content cleanup outside clock. Exact arbitrary capacities and every mutation operation are required before production selection, not established by this narrow screen.
Pre-timing: independent query and full-content cleanup oracles, geometry, zero query allocation and final-zero allocation ledger; report all bytes (predicted200/2184 per8slots), no hidden allocation. Native queries must load one packed control word per group, skip slot tag/key reads on nonmatching fingerprints, contain no unexpected hot helper call, and retain actual enum validation before payload access. Record any bound guards and their cost rather than assume a private cross-field invariant. Keep peer query bytes and addresses invariant where comparing paired images.
Measurement: two reversed cohorts,9seeds,2097152queries each, retain all raw rows and adverse observations. Report same-input ratios as attribution plus existing full-range and10percent stability qualification; no success from instruction counts alone. A repeatable query improvement without a separated query regression justifies implementing full mutation/ownership protocols for further evaluation, not immediate replacement. A failed native mechanism or repeatable query regression rejects this shape; preserve exact source and grounds. Do not infer a required language primitive merely from failure of this representation.
group8_screen.decision: reject this Group8 shape for repeatable separated hit regressions; no full mutation/ownership implementation
limitations: Fixed capacities divisible by eight only; no arbitrary tails or mutation/ownership API qualification.
Candidate changes representation as a whole; control-word skip is verified, but measured loss is not attributed to one native instruction.
Cumulative WF library runtime/zero-allocation and peer capacity controls are preserved; this control does not qualify the user target.
group8_screen.native: Reached Group8 query bodies 189 instructions and 80-byte frame; one packed control-word load/fingerprint mask skips tags and keys on no match, actual enum validation remains before payload, no hot calls/spills; peer query bytes/addresses identical to enum-domain image. Once/query division retained.
group8_screen.result_summary: All four hit shapes show separated Group8 regressions in both cohorts: median candidate/control ratios 1.719–1.887; candidate minimum exceeds control maximum by at least 1.60. Miss medians 1.021–1.150 slower, with overlapping ranges.
